title: Dated economy indicator observation
reason:
Provisional Phase 1 concept only. Fresh Phase 2 must decide existing-meaning reuse, equivalence and distinctions. It is not a canonical definition or accepted source mapping.

Phase 2 UNRESOLVED: An observation needs feature/support, property, measure, unit, period, method and quality. Grid context is not station measurement; nearby water stage is not flood risk. Rates, totals, current population and dated population cannot be interchanged. Preserve geography version, aggregation and denominator; no causal or individual inference from contextual series. Definition gap: the candidate combines source roles or lacks a sufficiently bounded reusable definition and binding domain. Retain the candidate; do not infer absence from literal query results.
